# Manual Hindi semantic review — batch 090

Date: 2026-10-14  
Scope: English sense indices 2225–2249, 25 senses

I reread every English definition and source example and checked the Hindi gloss and example individually. I rewrote all 25 gloss/example pairs in natural Hindi. Several entries had examples for a different sense or context, including `pilot`, `resolution`, `seed`, `initiative`, `motion`, `reputation`, `negotiation`, `crash`, and `observation`; these were aligned with the English source.

Changed: 25 Hindi gloss/example pairs.

Progress: 2,250/8,837 Hindi word senses independently checked (25.46%); 6,587 remain.

This batch does not complete the overall semantic review; more batches remain.
